description: TY2026: MFS whose spouse itemizes — standard deduction zeroed (SS 63(c)(6)(A)), so itemizing wins with the HALVED MFS SALT cap: $30,000 paid, capped at $20,200 (half of $40,400; MAGI 150,000 below the halved $252,500 threshold). TI = 150,000 - 20,200 = 129,800. Tax: 1,240+4,560+12,166+24%x(129,800-105,700)=5,784 -> 23,750. Additional Medicare 0.9%x(150,000-125,000 MFS threshold)=225. Net $23,975.00.
